mpnet_layer.doc: Post-LN transformer encoder block (BERT): LN(x + attn(x)), then LN(x + MLP(x)). Takes a relative position bias shared by every layer (MPNet). Padding positions are masked out of attention.

pre_ln_block.doc: Pre-LN transformer block (GPT-2, ViT): x + attn(LN(x)), then x + MLP(LN(x)).

post_ln_block.doc: Post-LN transformer encoder block (BERT): LN(x + attn(x)), then LN(x + MLP(x)).

llama_block.doc: Llama-style decoder layer: RMSNorm → GQA with RoPE → residual → RMSNorm → SwiGLU → residual.

moe_block.doc: Mixtral-style layer: attention as in Llama, MLP replaced by top-k routed SwiGLU experts.

llama4_group.doc: Llama 4 (iRoPE): 3 RoPE layers with chunked attention and L2 QK-norm, then 1 NoPE layer with global attention; every MLP is a top-1 sigmoid-routed MoE with a shared expert.

decoder_block.doc: Transformer decoder layer: causal self-attention, cross-attention to the encoder, MLP (post-LN).

resnet_basic.doc: ResNet basic block: two 3×3 conv-BN with an identity shortcut.

resnet_basic_down.doc: ResNet basic block that halves H×W and changes channels; 1×1 conv shortcut.

double_conv.doc: U-Net double convolution: (3×3 conv → BN → ReLU) × 2.

inverted_residual.doc: MobileNetV2 inverted residual: 1×1 expand → 3×3 depthwise → 1×1 linear projection, identity shortcut.

inverted_residual_proj.doc: MobileNetV2 inverted residual that changes channels or stride (no shortcut).
